subject: English
passage: In 2018, nearly 150 years after the death of Mary Anning, the Royal Society of ______ the achievements of the pioneering 19th-century paleontologist and discoverer of numerous marine fossils, establishing a research fellowship in her honor.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. It's the only choice that offers a form of the verb "recognize" that can go with the subject "Royal Society of London" to make a complete sentence. This might seem like an odd use of "would," but when speaking from a point of view in the past, we can actually use "would" to express something that happened later. That's the case here: 150 years after Mary Anning's death, the Royal Society would finally recognize her achievements.
